production.coldProtocol: create a fresh dedicated module Worker, instantiate the release WASM module, fetch and load the R1-B zero debug NNUE exactly once, and record elapsed milliseconds
production.warmProtocol: reuse that Worker and loaded NNUE, send usinewgame before every game, replay the full start SFEN and move list before every search, and never reload WASM or NNUE
production.hostClass: x86_64 Linux desktop CPU; Google Chrome with WebAssembly SIMD128, ES modules, dedicated Workers, and performance.now
production.deviceClass: x86_64 desktop CPU with WebAssembly SIMD128
production.memoryConfiguration: one Worker, one UsiEngine, one loaded debug NNUE, default 8 MiB TT

schedule.pairPolicy: game 2p uses A as Black and B as White; game 2p+1 uses B as Black and A as White; both start from byte-identical SFEN

timingLimits.latenessDefinition: max(0, wall elapsed measured around UsiEngine.send(go) minus requested move time)
timingLimits.schedulerDelayDefinition: performance.now at search entry minus the immediately preregistered dispatch timestamp
timingLimits.percentileMethod: nearest-rank ceil(q*n), fixed after all scheduled searches

statisticalLimits.analysis: fixed-cap complete-pair normal interval; no sequential peeking
statisticalLimits.rationale: Identical deterministic engines on an exactly color-swapped fixed schedule must produce pair score 0.5 for every opening. This yields a degenerate zero-bias paired interval; any nonzero pair score or malformed pair fails closed.

qualification.allowedPartialRootMoves: searched only and reported per search
failClosed: colors or engine order not swapped
bin mismatch between raw games and report

nativeEquivalence.require: production WASM and native UsiSession must agree on bestmove and typed root-result fields; the native in-process history-bearing adapter must agree on the best move
